description: A strong cord of twisted animal gut used for a minimal bead-and-loop fastening: a bead is threaded on, the doubled ends are laced into one board, and a matching loop laced into the other catches over the projecting bead.
name: catgut

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (D. Appleton, 1901), Internet Archive
